data.gender_notes: Manoj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Manoj is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'manas' meaning 'mind' and 'jna' meaning 'knowledge'. This name is given to a child who is expected to use their intellect and wisdom to make informed decisions. In Hindu mythology, Manoj is the name of a divine being associated with the mind and intellect. The name Manoj carries the meaning “Mind, Intellect” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Manoj usually hope their child will grow to embody mind, intellect and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Furthermore, Hindu mythology includes several stories and scriptures that praise the importance of intellect and knowledge.
